no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: LifeVantage is a nutrigenomics direct-selling (MLM) company commercializing dietary supplements (Protandim Nrf2/NRF1 Synergizers, MindBody GLP-1 System, ProBio, Omega+, etc.) and personal-care products (TrueScience).
